entities.summary: Kadambari Devi was the wife of Bengali intellect Jyotirindranath Tagore. A member of Tagore family, she was the sister-in-law of Rabindranath Tagore. Between the spring and autumn of 1883, Jyotirindranath, Kadambari and Rabindranath lived in Karwar. Today she's mostly known for her close relationship with Rabindranath. She committed suicide on April 1884.
